Ashbourne House

The house ledger

Drawing room
Brush the green velvet against the pile. Leave the hearth damper open until the last of the embers have cooled.
Kitchen
The old iron stove is gone. We kept its tiles for the splashback and set new clay pavers where the flagstones had split.
Upstairs
Keep the oak on the landing bare at the edges. The indigo runner was cut narrow so the old boards would still show.
